title: Tally + ChatGPT: My 3-Tool Stack
caption:
If I started over, I'd fix your tools first

Most people get this wrong. Avoid these:
1️⃣ Tally — Notion-style forms that read like a conversation — free to start
2️⃣ ChatGPT — the generalist — best used with a saved system prompt, not one-off asks
3️⃣ Descript — edit video by editing the transcript — delete a word, delete the clip

Which one are you guilty of? Comment below.
